projects.name: portfolio update
observations: Jordan had been dreading this since July, treating it as an enormous unstarted mountain.
Jordan opened it and found the Meridian work solid, three case studies of internal tools that measurably worked.
The Coda case study was the piece that made it good.
Jordan wrote up the Coda case study properly for the first time, including the problem, practice log, metronome, quick-start cards, and free-play mode.

projects.name: Coda
observations: Includes a practice log, metronome, and quick-start cards.
Has a free-play mode that originated from Dev asking if it could track when he noodles.
Free-play mode included a timestamp idea.
On Thursday, Dev used it as a bug tracker while Jordan had built it as a trophy case.
Jordan dogfooded the feature daily for nine days and could not see the issue because they were the wrong user.
Jordan built it at a coffee shop to feel better on bad days.
Mika suggested on July 31st that Coda could be the portfolio update.
